description: What a secondhand item sells for on eBay: a calibrated estimate with a range, the recent real eBay sales behind it (sold comps, linked where the source gives a link), three list prices (fast, market, patient) with the 14-day sell chance, what the seller keeps after eBay fees, and a worth-it verdict when you pass what the user would pay. Description prices are eBay US in USD. A photo price (image_url, a public https link) needs the user signed in through the connector: it runs a real scan on their account, priced in their own eBay marketplace and currency (price.currency). Without sign-in, describe the item; a description works but reads less than a photo.

condition.description: Condition as the user states it.

cost.description: What the user paid or would pay for it, for a worth-it verdict: in USD, or in the seller's own currency for a photo scan on a signed-in account.

description.description: What the item is: brand, model or pattern, size, any marks, completeness.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a photo of the item. Preferred over description alone.

name: price_item
title: Price an item
